title: Admidio from 5.0.17 before 5.0.18 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users…
description: Admidio versions from 5.0.17 up to but not including 5.0.18 contain a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability. Authenticated users can inject malicious JavaScript code via the STREET profile field. This injected script executes when role managers hover over the address icon in the members_assignment_data.php page, potentially compromising their session.
